recipe.title: Place concurrent workloads on eligible cluster nodes
recipe.scenario: Place three concurrent workloads on three eligible nodes for the same reservation window. Candidate lists come from a separate resource and label check. Reserve each chosen node for at most one workload, and prefer Compute C for the GPU batch job when feasible. This example does not implement a Kubernetes scheduler or model cumulative resource usage, preemption, topology, or live deployment.

field.name: workload-names
field.description: Concurrent workloads to be placed, in index order: GPU batch job, Search index rebuild, Analytics export.

field.name: node-names
field.description: Candidate node names, in index order: Compute A, Compute B, Compute C. Indices start at zero.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Consecutive zero-based workload and node index pairs: 0,0; 0,2; 1,0; 1,1; 2,1; 2,2. These are the only eligible choices.

field.name: preferred-first-workload-node
field.description: Node index preferred for the GPU batch job (index 2 is Compute C). Omit this field for no preference; it cannot override eligibility or unique use.

field.name: assigned-nodes
field.description: For a feasible plan: One node index per workload, in workload order. With the example preference the result is [2,0,1].
